title: Stress–strain and force–extension behaviour; Electric potential and potential energy; Newton's law of gravitation and field strength

assemble.prompt: Match each term to its definition.

items.label: Volt
items.clue: Name of the unit equal to 1 J C⁻¹.

items.label: Gravitational field strength
items.clue: Force per unit mass on a small test mass, in N kg⁻¹.

items.label: Uniform field
items.clue: Model used near the surface, where g barely changes.

items.label: Inverse-square law
items.clue: Pattern in which doubling r divides the pull by four.

questions.stem: Two objects exert gravitational forces of magnitude F on each other. The mass of each object is doubled, and the distance between their centres is tripled. What is the new magnitude of the gravitational force that each object exerts on the other?

A point charge of +5.0 nC is fixed in place. A second charge of +2.0 nC is moved slowly from a point 0.30 m from the fixed charge to a point 0.10 m from it. Take 1/(4πε₀) = 8.99 × 10⁹ N m² C⁻². What is the work done on the +2.0 nC charge by the external force?

The Earth exerts a gravitational force of 2.0 × 10²⁰ N on the Moon. The mass of the Moon is about 1.2% of the mass of the Earth. Which statement about the gravitational force that the Moon exerts on the Earth is correct?

options.text: It is 2.0 × 10²⁰ N, and it pulls the Earth towards the Moon.
It is about 1.2% of 2.0 × 10²⁰ N, as the Moon has far less mass.
It is zero, as a small body cannot attract a much larger one.
It is zero, as the Moon has no air and so has no gravity.

questions.stem: In a region of uniform electric field of strength 4.0 × 10³ V m⁻¹ directed in the +x direction, point A at x = 0 has an electric potential of +500 V. What is the electric potential at point B, at x = 0.050 m?

Star X (mass 9.0 × 10³⁰ kg) and star Y (mass 1.0 × 10³⁰ kg) are 4.0 × 10¹¹ m apart, centre to centre. At one point on the line joining their centres, the resultant gravitational field strength is zero. How far is this point from the centre of X?
questions.explanation: GM_X/x² = GM_Y/(d − x)², so x/(d − x) = √(9.0/1.0) = 3, and x = ¾ × 4.0 × 10¹¹ = 3.0 × 10¹¹ m: nearer the smaller mass.
